verses.en: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.
verses.pt: Ora, houve uma longa guerra entre a casa de Saul e a casa de Davi; porém Davi se fortalecia cada vez mais, enquanto a casa de Saul cada vez mais se enfraquecia.
verses.en_web: Now there was long war between Saul’s house and David’s house. David grew stronger and stronger, but Saul’s house grew weaker and weaker.
verses.en_bbe: Now there was a long war between Saul's people and David's people; and David became stronger and stronger, but those on Saul's side became more and more feeble.

verses.en: And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
verses.pt: Nasceram filhos a Davi em Hebrom. Seu primogênito foi Amnom, de Ainoã, a jizreelita;
verses.en_web: Sons were born to David in Hebron. His firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
verses.en_bbe: While David was in Hebron he became the father of sons: the oldest was Amnon, son of Ahinoam of Jezreel;

verses.en: And his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
verses.pt: o segundo Quileabe, de Abigail, que fôra mulher de Nabal, o carmelita; o terceiro Absalão, filho de Maacá, filha de Talmai, rei de Gesur;
verses.en_web: and his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
verses.en_bbe: And the second, Chileab, whose mother was Abigail, the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom, son of Maacah, the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur;

verses.en: And the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
verses.pt: o quarto Adonias, filho de Hagite, o quinto Sefatias, filho de Abital;
verses.en_web: and the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
verses.en_bbe: And the fourth, Adonijah, the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah, the son of Abital;

verses.en: And the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.
verses.pt: e o sexto Itreão, de Eglá, também mulher de Davi; estes nasceram a Davi em Hebrom.
verses.en_web: and the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah, David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.
verses.en_bbe: And the sixth, Ithream, whose mother was David's wife Eglah. These were the sons of David, whose birth took place in Hebron.

verses.en: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul.
verses.pt: Enquanto havia guerra entre a casa de Saul e a casa de Davi, Abner ia se tornando poderoso na casa de Saul:
verses.en_web: While there was war between Saul’s house and David’s house, Abner made himself strong in Saul’s house.
verses.en_bbe: Now while there was war between Saul's people and David's people, Abner was making himself strong among the supporters of Saul.

verses.en: And Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and Ish-bosheth said to Abner, Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father’s concubine?
verses.pt: Ora, Saul tivera uma concubina, cujo nome era Rizpa, filha de Aías. Perguntou, pois, Isbosete a Abner: Por que entraste à concubina de meu pai?
verses.en_web: Now Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah; and Ishbosheth said to Abner, “Why have you gone in to my father’s concubine?”
verses.en_bbe: Now Saul had among his wives a woman named Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and Ish-bosheth said to Abner, Why have you taken my father's wife?

verses.en: Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ish-bosheth, and said, Am I a dog’s head, which against Judah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul thy father, to his brethren, and to his friends, and have not delivered thee into the hand of David, that thou chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman?
verses.pt: Então Abner, irando-se muito pelas palavras de Isbosete, disse: Sou eu cabeça de cão, que pertença a Judá? Ainda hoje uso de benevolência para com a casa de Saul, teu pai, e para com seus irmãos e seus amigos, e não te entreguei nas mãos de Davi; contudo tu hoje queres culpar-me no tocante a essa mulher.
verses.en_web: Then Abner was very angry about Ishbosheth’s words, and said, “Am I a dog’s head that belongs to Judah? Today I show kindness to Saul’s house your father, to his brothers, and to his friends, and have not delivered you into the hand of David; and yet you charge me today with a fault concerning this woman!
verses.en_bbe: And Abner was very angry at the words of Ish-bosheth, and he said, Am I a dog's head of Judah? I am this day doing all in my power for the cause of your father Saul and for his brothers and his friends, and have not given you up into the hands of David, and now you say I have done wrong with a woman.

verses.en: So do God to Abner, and more also, except, as the LORD hath sworn to David, even so I do to him;
verses.pt: Assim faça Deus a Abner, e outro tanto, se, como o Senhor jurou a Davi, assim eu não lhe fizer,
verses.en_web: God do so to Abner, and more also, if, as Yahweh has sworn to David, I don’t do even so to him;
verses.en_bbe: May God's punishment be on Abner, if I do not for David as the Lord in his oath has said,

verses.en: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beer-sheba.
verses.pt: transferindo o reino da casa de Saul, e estabelecendo o trono de Davi sobre Israel, e sobre Judá, desde Dã até Berseba.
verses.en_web: to transfer the kingdom from Saul’s house, and to set up David’s throne over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.”
verses.en_bbe: And if I do not take away the kingdom from the family of Saul and make David ruler over Israel and Judah from Dan as far as Beer-sheba!

verses.en: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him.
verses.pt: E Isbosete não pôde responder a Abner mais uma palavra, porque o temia.
verses.en_web: He could not answer Abner another word, because he was afraid of him.
verses.en_bbe: And so great was Ish-bosheth's fear of Abner that he was not able to say a word in answer.

verses.en: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, Whose is the land? saying also, Make thy league with me, and, behold, my hand shall be with thee, to bring about all Israel unto thee.
verses.pt: Então enviou Abner da sua parte mensageiros a Davi, dizendo: De quem é a terra? Comigo faze a tua aliança, e eis que a minha mão será contigo, para fazer tornar a ti todo o Israel.
verses.en_web: Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, “Whose is the land?” and saying, “Make your alliance with me, and behold, my hand will be with you, to bring all Israel around to you.”
verses.en_bbe: And Abner sent men to David at Hebron, saying, Make an agreement with me, and I will give you my support in getting all Israel on your side.

verses.en: And he said, Well; I will make a league with thee: but one thing I require of thee, that is, Thou shalt not see my face, except thou first bring Michal Saul’s daughter, when thou comest to see my face.
verses.pt: Respondeu Davi: Está bem; farei aliança contigo; mas uma coisa te exijo; não verás a minha face, se primeiro não me trouxeres Mical, filha de Saul, quando vieres ver a minha face.
verses.en_web: He said, “Good. I will make a treaty with you, but one thing I require of you. That is, you will not see my face unless you first bring Michal, Saul’s daughter, when you come to see my face.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, It is well; I will make an agreement with you, but on one condition, which is, that when you come before me, Saul's daughter Michal is to come with you; till she comes you will not see my face.

verses.en: And David sent messengers to Ish-bosheth Saul’s son, saying, Deliver me my wife Michal, which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines.
verses.pt: Também enviou Davi mensageiros a Isbosete, filho de Saul, dizendo: Entrega-me minha mulher Mical, que eu desposei por cem prepúcios de filisteus.
verses.en_web: David sent messengers to Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, saying, “Deliver me my wife Michal, whom I was given to marry for one hundred foreskins of the Philistines.”
verses.en_bbe: And David sent men to Saul's son Ish-bosheth, saying, Give me back Michal, my wife, whom I made mine for the price of the private parts of a hundred Philistines.

verses.en: And Ish-bosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from Phaltiel the son of Laish.
verses.pt: Enviou, pois, Isbosete, e a tirou a seu marido, a Paltiel, filho de Laís,
verses.en_web: Ishbosheth sent and took her from her husband, even from Paltiel the son of Laish.
verses.en_bbe: So Ish-bosheth sent and took her from her husband Paltiel, the son of Laish.

verses.en: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim. Then said Abner unto him, Go, return. And he returned.
verses.pt: que a seguia, chorando atrás dela até Baurim. Então lhe disse Abner: Vai-te; volta! E ele voltou.
verses.en_web: Her husband went with her, weeping as he went, and followed her to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, “Go! Return!” and he returned.
verses.en_bbe: And her husband went with her as far as Bahurim, weeping while he went. Then Abner said to him, Go back. And he went back.

verses.en: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, Ye sought for David in times past to be king over you:
verses.pt: Falou Abner com os anciãos de Israel, dizendo: De há muito procurais fazer com que Davi reine sobre vós;
verses.en_web: Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, “In times past, you sought for David to be king over you.
verses.en_bbe: Then Abner had a talk with the chief men of Israel, saying, In the past it was your desire to make David your king: so now, do it:

verses.en: Now then do it: for the LORD hath spoken of David, saying, By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.
verses.pt: fazei-o, pois, agora, porque o Senhor falou de Davi, dizendo: Pela mão do meu servo Davi livrarei o meu povo da mão dos filisteus e da mão de todos os seus inimigos.
verses.en_web: Now then do it; for Yahweh has spoken of David, saying, ‘By the hand of my servant David, I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.’”
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord has said of David, By the hand of my servant David I will make my people Israel safe from the Philistines, and from all who are against them.

verses.en: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel, and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin.
verses.pt: Do mesmo modo falou Abner a Benjamim, e foi também dizer a Davi, em Hebrom, tudo o que Israel e toda a casa de Benjamim tinham resolvido.
verses.en_web: Abner also spoke in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel, and to the whole house of Benjamin.
verses.en_bbe: And Abner said the same things to Benjamin: and he went to David in Hebron to make clear to him what seemed good to Israel and to all the people of Benjamin.

verses.en: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast.
verses.pt: Abner foi ter com Davi, em Hebrom, com vinte homens; e Davi fez um banquete a Abner e aos homens que com ele estavam.
verses.en_web: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. David made Abner and the men who were with him a feast.
verses.en_bbe: So Abner, with twenty men, came to Hebron, to David. And David made a feast for Abner and the men who were with him.

verses.en: And Abner said unto David, I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king, that they may make a league with thee, and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth. And David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.
verses.pt: Então disse Abner a Davi: Eu me levantarei, e irei ajuntar ao rei meu senhor todo o Israel, para que faça aliança contigo; e tu reinarás sobre tudo o que desejar a sua alma: Assim despediu Davi a Abner, e ele se foi em paz.
verses.en_web: Abner said to David, “I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may reign over all that your soul desires.” David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.
verses.en_bbe: And Abner said to David, Now I will go, and make all Israel come to my lord the king, so that they may make an agreement with you, and your kingdom may be as wide as your heart's desire. Then David sent Abner away and he went in peace.

verses.en: And, Behold, the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner was not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.
verses.pt: Eis que os servos de Davi e Joabe voltaram de uma sortida, e traziam consigo grande despojo; mas Abner já não estava com Davi em Hebrom, porque este o tinha despedido, e ele se fora em paz.
verses.en_web: Behold, David’s servants and Joab came from a raid, and brought in a great plunder with them; but Abner was not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.
verses.en_bbe: Now the servants of David and Joab had been out attacking a band of armed men, and they came back with a great store of goods taken in the fight: but Abner was no longer in Hebron with David, for he had sent him away and he had gone in peace.

verses.en: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he hath sent him away, and he is gone in peace.
verses.pt: Quando, pois, chegaram Joabe e todo o exército que vinha com ele, disseram-lhe: Abner, filho de Ner, veio ter com o rei; e o rei o despediu, e ele se foi em paz.
verses.en_web: When Joab and all the army who was with him had come, they told Joab, “Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he has sent him away, and he has gone in peace.”
verses.en_bbe: When Joab and his men came, news was given them that Abner, the son of Ner, had come to the king, who had let him go away again in peace.

verses.en: Then Joab came to the king, and said, What hast thou done? behold, Abner came unto thee; why is it that thou hast sent him away, and he is quite gone?
verses.pt: Então Joabe foi ao rei, e disse: Que fizeste? Eis que Abner veio ter contigo; por que, pois, o despediste, de maneira que se fosse assim livremente?
verses.en_web: Then Joab came to the king, and said, “What have you done? Behold, Abner came to you. Why is it that you have sent him away, and he is already gone?
verses.en_bbe: Then Joab came to the king, and said, What have you done? when Abner came to you why did you send him away and let him go?

verses.en: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive thee, and to know thy going out and thy coming in, and to know all that thou doest.
verses.pt: Bem conheces a Abner, filho de Ner; ele te veio enganar, e saber a tua saída e a tua entrada, e conhecer tudo quanto fazes.
verses.en_web: You know Abner the son of Ner. He came to deceive you, and to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all that you do.”
verses.en_bbe: Is it not clear to you that Abner, the son of Ner, came with deceit to get knowledge of your going out and your coming in and of all you are doing?

verses.en: And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but David knew it not.
verses.pt: E Joabe, retirando-se de Davi, enviou mensageiros atrás de Abner, que o fizeram voltar do poço de Sira, sem que Davi o soubesse.
verses.en_web: When Joab had come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the well of Sirah; but David didn’t know it.
verses.en_bbe: And when Joab had come out from David, he sent men after Abner, and they overtook him at the water-spring of Sirah, and made him come back with them: but David had no knowledge of it.

verses.en: And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth rib, that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.
verses.pt: Quando Abner voltou a Hebrom, Joabe o tomou à parte, à entrada da porta, para lhe falar em segredo; e ali, por causa do sangue de Asael, seu irmão, o feriu no ventre, de modo que ele morreu.
verses.en_web: When Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into the middle of the gate to speak with him quietly, and struck him there in the body, so that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.
verses.en_bbe: And when Abner was back in Hebron, Joab took him on one side by the doorway of the town to have a word with him quietly, and there he gave him a wound in the stomach, causing his death in payment for the death of his brother Asahel.

verses.en: And afterward when David heard it, he said, I and my kingdom are guiltless before the LORD for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner:
verses.pt: Depois Davi, quando o soube, disse: Inocente para sempre sou eu, e o meu reino, para com o Senhor, no tocante ao sangue de Abner, filho de Ner.
verses.en_web: Afterward, when David heard it, he said, “I and my kingdom are guiltless before Yahweh forever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner.
verses.en_bbe: And when David had word of it he said, May I and my kingdom be clear for ever in the eyes of the Lord from the blood of Abner, the son of Ner:

verses.en: Let it rest on the head of Joab, and on all his father’s house; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue, or that is a leper, or that leaneth on a staff, or that falleth on the sword, or that lacketh bread.
verses.pt: Caia ele sobre a cabeça de Joabe e sobre toda a casa de seu pai, e nunca falte na casa de Joabe quem tenha fluxo, ou quem seja leproso, ou quem se atenha a bordão, ou quem caia à espada, ou quem necessite de pão.
verses.en_web: Let it fall on the head of Joab, and on all his father’s house. Let there not fail from the house of Joab one who has an issue, or who is a leper, or who leans on a staff, or who falls by the sword, or who lacks bread.”
verses.en_bbe: May it come on the head of Joab and all his father's family: among the men of Joab's family may there ever be some who are diseased or lepers, or who do the work of women, or are put to the sword, or are wasted from need of food!

verses.en: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.
verses.pt: Joabe, pois, e Abisai, seu irmão, mataram Abner, por ter ele morto a Asael, irmão deles, na peleja em Gibeão.
verses.en_web: So Joab and Abishai his brother killed Abner, because he had killed their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.
verses.en_bbe: So Joab and Abishai his brother put Abner to death, because he had put to death their brother Asahel in the fight at Gibeon.

verses.en: And David said to Joab, and to all the people that were with him, Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. And king David himself followed the bier.
verses.pt: Disse Davi a Joabe e a todo o povo que com ele estava: Rasgai as vossas vestes, cingi-vos de sacos e ide pranteando diante de Abner. E o rei Davi ia seguindo o féretro.
verses.en_web: David said to Joab, and to all the people who were with him, “Tear your clothes, and clothe yourselves with sackcloth, and mourn in front of Abner.” King David followed the bier.
verses.en_bbe: And David said to Joab and all the people who were with him, Go in grief and put haircloth about you, in sorrow for Abner. And King David went after the dead body.

verses.en: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.
verses.pt: Sepultaram Abner em Hebrom; e o rei, levantando a sua voz, chorou junto da sepultura de Abner; chorou também todo o povo.
verses.en_web: They buried Abner in Hebron; and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at Abner’s grave; and all the people wept.
verses.en_bbe: And they put Abner's body to rest in Hebron; and the king and all the people were weeping loudly by the resting-place of Abner's body.

verses.en: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?
verses.pt: Pranteou o rei a Abner, dizendo: Devia Abner, porventura, morrer como morre o vilão?
verses.en_web: The king lamented for Abner, and said, “Should Abner die as a fool dies?
verses.en_bbe: And the king made a song of grief for Abner and said, Was the death of Abner to be like the death of a foolish man?

verses.en: Thy hands were not bound, nor thy feet put into fetters: as a man falleth before wicked men, so fellest thou. And all the people wept again over him.
verses.pt: As tuas mãos não estavam atadas, nem os teus pés carregados de grilhões; mas caíste como quem cai diante dos filhos da iniqüidade. Então todo o povo tornou a chorar por ele.
verses.en_web: Your hands weren’t bound, and your feet weren’t put into fetters. As a man falls before the children of iniquity, so you fell.” All the people wept again over him.
verses.en_bbe: Your hands were free, your feet were not chained: like the downfall of a man before evil men, so was your fall. And the weeping of the people over him went on again.

verses.en: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day, David sware, saying, So do God to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.
verses.pt: Depois todo o povo veio fazer com que Davi comesse pão, sendo ainda dia; porém Davi jurou, dizendo: Assim Deus me faça e outro tanto, se, antes que o sol se ponha, eu provar pão ou qualquer outra coisa.
verses.en_web: All the people came to urge David to eat bread while it was yet day; but David swore, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or anything else, until the sun goes down.”
verses.en_bbe: And the people came to make David take food, while it was still day, but David with an oath said, May God's punishment be on me if I take a taste of bread or any other thing till the sun has gone down!

verses.en: And all the people took notice of it, and it pleased them: as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people.
verses.pt: Todo o povo notou isso, e pareceu-lhe bem; assim como tudo quanto o rei fez pareceu bem a todo o povo.
verses.en_web: All the people took notice of it, and it pleased them; as whatever the king did pleased all the people.
verses.en_bbe: And all the people took note of it and were pleased: like everything the king did, it was pleasing to the people.

verses.en: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.
verses.pt: Assim todo o povo e todo o Israel entenderam naquele mesmo dia que não fora a vontade do rei que matassem a Abner, filho de Ner.
verses.en_web: So all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to kill Abner the son of Ner.
verses.en_bbe: So it was clear to Israel and to all the people on that day that the king was not responsible for the death of Abner, the son of Ner.

verses.en: And the king said unto his servants, Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel?
verses.pt: Então disse o rei aos seus servos: Não sabeis que hoje caiu em Israel um príncipe, um grande homem?
verses.en_web: The king said to his servants, “Don’t you know that there a prince and a great man has fallen today in Israel?
verses.en_bbe: And the king said to his servants, Do you not see that a chief and a great man has come to his end today in Israel?

verses.en: And I am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me: the LORD shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness.
verses.pt: E quanto a mim, hoje estou fraco, embora ungido rei; estes homens, filhos de Zeruia, são duros demais para mim. Retribua o Senhor ao malfeitor conforme a sua maldade.
verses.en_web: I am weak today, though anointed king. These men, the sons of Zeruiah are too hard for me. May Yahweh reward the evildoer according to his wickedness.”
verses.en_bbe: While I, though I am crowned king, have little strength, and these men, the sons of Zeruiah, are out of my control: may the Lord give to the evil-doer the reward of his evil-doing!
